title: Global Optimization of Renewal Switching-Duration Laws for Pure-Exposure Horvitz-Thompson Risk
banked_reason: D0.5 delivered incremental below field floor; no bounded fix in scope. Unrestricted global no-gap completeness, attainment, and decisive two-rate comparison remain open.
gap_reasons: The delivered global quantitative result is the broad bracket approximately 4.064 to 12, with guaranteed matching only above an additive tolerance approximately 7.936; it provides limited discrimination among competitive schedules.

Cleaning and whole-frequency recovery establish specialized boundary results, but neither exhaustive representation and recovery of minimizing sequences nor convergence of finite all-law lower covers follows from them.

The total upper enumeration follows from encoded-density approximation and certificate existence, and supplies neither a global stopping criterion nor delivered computational evidence of useful optimization performance.

Panel decision verdict: REVISE only for ballast@prop:exponential-check — delete the unconsumed exponential sanity illustration or retain its normalization point as prose. This finding remains unrepaired because the cold tier, not ballast, caused the terminal halt.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 developed unrestricted rational covariance-test lower certificates, a total upper optimizing sequence without a computable error modulus, impulse-boundary cleaning and recovery in two regular regimes, and partial two-rate boundary charts. The delivered bracket is approximately 4.064 to 12, with unconditional matching only above a gap of approximately 7.936; escaping-frequency recovery, finite all-law cover completeness, attainment and decisive two-rate comparison remain open after maximality review. D0.5 math passed with all five cited substrates attested, but the delivered contribution graded incremental below the field floor; no Lean formalization was entered.
tldr: The retained pure-exposure Horvitz--Thompson estimator has the established exact fixed-design asymptotic causal risk \(J(g)\). Over the original unrestricted duration-density class, the proved hierarchy is \(c_{\mathrm{quad}}\le\lambda_{\mathrm{cert}}\le J^\star\le J_2^\star\le12\), with \(0\le J^\star-\lambda_{\mathrm{cert}}\le12-c_{\mathrm{quad}}<8\). Matching search is partial and sound whenever it returns; it is proved to return for every rational \(\varepsilon>12-c_{\mathrm{quad}}\), including every rational \(\varepsilon\ge8\). A separate total upper search produces legal encoded schedules with certified endpoints decreasing to \(J^\star\), without a proved computable error modulus. Every bounded-risk impulse datum can be cleaned at no increase of either channel's supremum covariance-test risk. Legal whole-frequency risk recovery is proved for all positive-drift data with finite jump first moment and for zero-drift finite jump measures with Fourier decay. Two-rate sublevel bounds, a uniform terminal-atom chart, and lattice-corner exclusion are established. The global no-gap equality, remaining recoveries, attainment, complete-family fine certification, and decisive two-rate comparison remain open.
gap: Hu supplies a sharp risk criterion and a numerical hazard-family search, while the inspected internal benchmark-improvement note explicitly stops before unrestricted optimality. Neither source establishes a global lower certificate.
fill: Finite encoded schedules and replayable certificates deliver an arbitrary-precision global optimality gap on the original full class. Checker soundness, spectral recovery and terminating completeness are theorem obligations. Attainment remains a separate mathematical question; the complete two-rate corollary requires boundary certification and an exact equality or strict-separation record.
